title: governance: `.github/workflows/**` joins this repository's governed surfaces — the AGENTS.md 受管面 list (five → six) and the queue guard's `GOVERNED_SURFACES` register — a workflow PR waits for an authorised approval (ruled A)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) on the maintainer's word 「两仓加治理行」 (2026-10-12), the answer A to the seat's question. Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. ⛔ Not a claim. Tier H: `AGENTS.md` is in the diff, so the PR stays a draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member approves it; the seat then lands it.

## Why
`AGENTS.md`'s section 「⛔ 受管面」 lists five surfaces (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`) and `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`'s `GOVERNED_SURFACES` has the same five rows; `--test` over PR #12232's and PR #12250's twelve workflow paths answered NOT GOVERNED (objectui#12214 report 6123124321; objectui#12240 report 6124777533). This round every CI PR here waited for the maintainer's approval, and cloud wrote the row into its table (cloud#2809, PR #2810); the objectstack sibling card adds the same row to its register in the same act.

## What to build
1. **The register row** in `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: `{ id: 'workflows', prefix: '.github/workflows/', glob: '.github/workflows/**', what: 'CI, deploy and release workflows: what runs on every push, what deploys, what gates the queue' }`, and its test (`scripts/__tests__/check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts`): a workflow path → GOVERNED; `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**` and `.github/dependabot.yml` → not.
2. **`AGENTS.md` 「本仓的受管面 —— 五项」 → six**, one bullet in the section's own wording (CI、部署与发版 workflow 决定每次 push 跑什么、拿什么门禁挡合并队列，改它们由维护者批准), and the sentences that say "五项" or enumerate the five move with it; the header comment of the guard (its restated list) likewise.
3. **Consumers:** `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` read the register or the list (grep `GOVERNED_SURFACES`): move any enumeration honestly; `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml`'s `paths:` filter, if it enumerates the surfaces, gains the glob (⛔ the guard must still fire on a workflow-only PR).
4. Nothing else: no tier mechanism exists here (the two legs stay as they are), no change to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`.

## Acceptance
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` exit 0 and `--test .github/workflows/ci.yml` answers GOVERNED; the guard's `pull_request` leg on the PR itself reads GOVERNED (the PR touches `AGENTS.md`); the PR body lists the six surfaces and every file touched.

Related: cloud#2809 (PR #2810) · the objectstack sibling card (filed in the same act) · objectui#12214 · objectui#12240 · `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` · `AGENTS.md` 「受管面」.
